Sleeve-sponsor owners not traced in this pass (owner left null): MrQ (Lindar Media?), CHEXX, Cazoo, HiBob, Stake (Easygo?), Bally's Intralot (Bally's Corporation + Intralot joint), BoyleSports, KChat, Play (Ed Sheeran tour), Shuffle, McVitie's (Pladis/Yildiz Holding), Geely Auto UK (Zhejiang Geely Holding Group).

Manchester United: Microsoft Surface features on the back of match-day shirts only during selective fixtures (e.g. domestic cup matches); Betway is the training-kit partner (~GBP20m a year, manutd.com). Not a full-season back placement.
Premier League central partners: Sorare is no longer listed as an Official Licensee for 2026/27 (Score and Change); no new partners added this season.
Liverpool announced Turkish Airlines as main partner from 1 June 2027 (five-year, reported >GBP60m/yr), replacing Standard Chartered; a future deal, not on the 2026/27 shirt.

Kit suppliers (not sponsors rated here): 2026/27 PL kit deals include Adidas x Man Utd to 2035 (min GBP900m) and Puma x Man City 10-year extension worth GBP100m/yr; useful context, not on the shirt as a sponsor.
